item.title: Meat intended for freezing: EFSA assesses bacterial growth in meat before it reaches consumers
item.description: EFSA assessed how bacteria grow in meat from cattle, sheep and pigs during chilling, storage and defrosting. The way meat is stored by food business operators before it reaches consumers can affect how bacteria grow. This applies both to harmful bacteria such as Salmonella and Listeria, and to bacteria that spoil meat’s smell and appearance. […]
